sloka: पौरजानपदैश्चापि नैगमैश्च कृताञ्जलिः ।स्वयं वसिष्ठो भगवान् ब्राह्मणैः सह तिष्ठति ॥२-१४-५५॥
transliteration: paurajānapadaiścāpi naigamaiśca kṛtāñjaliḥ ।svayaṁ vasiṣṭho bhagavān brāhmaṇaiḥ saha tiṣṭhati ॥2-14-55॥

translations.english: Venerable Vasistha along with inhabitants of the city and countryside including merchants and brahmins with folded hands awaits you.
